user.title: Consumption source
user.description: Choose the hourly consumption to cost. Without a meter, leave it empty: the source then shows the prices, the Tempo colors and the heating. Add the contracts afterwards, from the entry's menu.

data_description.statistic_id: Hourly energy statistic of the meter, like the linky:… statistic the Linky app imports (named after the meter number). Costs and comparisons need it.

reconfigure.title: Change the consumption source
reconfigure.description: For example after a meter change. Every contract is costed again on the new statistic. Left empty, the source has no meter.

data_description.statistic_id: Hourly energy statistic of the meter, like the linky:… statistic the Linky app imports (named after the meter number). Costs and comparisons need it.

error.statistic_not_energy: This statistic isn't an energy (Wh, kWh…).
error.statistic_no_sum: This statistic has no running total: choose a consumption statistic, like the one the Linky app imports.
error.statistic_no_data: This statistic has no data yet.
error.statistic_daily: This statistic only has daily values: they can't be split between off-peak and peak hours. Enable the load curve (hourly consumption) in your Enedis account and in the Linky app.

init.title: Options
init.description: Costs and comparisons are on the [Contracts](/electricity-contracts) page of the sidebar.

data_description.temperature: Puts the consumption next to the weather, in the Heating tab. The sensor must keep statistics. It takes the place of Open-Meteo.
data_description.open_meteo: Without an outdoor sensor, takes the hourly outdoor temperature from Open-Meteo.com, free and without an account. Your home's location, rounded to about 10 km, is sent to Open-Meteo.

heating.name: Heating and hot water
heating.description: Optional: the statistics that measure your heating. Without them, the Heating tab estimates it from the consumption and the outdoor temperature.

data_description.heating_statistics: One or several energy totals (one per heater, or the gas meter); they are summed. Electric ones are already part of the consumption source.
data_description.heating_energy: Electricity is costed at the prices of your contracts, hour by hour; gas at the gas prices you add as "Gas price".
data_description.heating_content: When the statistics also hold the hot water, it is estimated from the days without heating, unless the water heater has its own statistic.
data_description.water_statistic: Its own statistic, if it is tracked separately: hot water is then measured.
data_description.indoor_temperatures: Averaged. The setting simulator starts from this temperature; without it, the simulator is off.

rte.name: Tempo backup: RTE's official API
rte.description: Optional, for when RTE's public calendar stops answering: create a free application for the "Tempo Like Supply Contract" API on data.rte-france.com and enter its credentials.

tempo_unavailable.title: Tempo colors can't be updated
tempo_unavailable.description:
RTE's public Tempo calendar hasn't answered properly since {since} ({error}), so the hours of {title} after that wait to be costed.

If RTE changed this calendar, the official API takes over: create a free application for the "Tempo Like Supply Contract" API on data.rte-france.com, then enter its credentials in the options of {title}. The waiting hours are costed as soon as colors arrive again.

tempo_unavailable_official.title: Tempo colors can't be updated
tempo_unavailable_official.description: Neither RTE's public Tempo calendar nor its official API has answered properly since {since} ({error}), so the hours of {title} after that wait to be costed. They are costed as soon as colors arrive again; nothing needs to be done if RTE is only down for a while.

prices_unavailable.title: Regulated prices can't be updated
prices_unavailable.description: The regulated prices couldn't be downloaded from data.gouv.fr since {since} ({error}). {title} keeps the prices it already has; a price change published since then isn't applied until the download works again.

rte_credentials_refused.title: RTE refuses the credentials
rte_credentials_refused.description: RTE's official API refused the client ID and secret set in the options of {title}. Check the application on data.rte-france.com and enter its credentials again, or clear both fields to use the public calendar only.

missing_price.title: {contract} has no price for {day}
missing_price.description:
{contract} is priced by hand, and no price period covers {day}: its costs stop on that day, and comparisons with it stop there too.

Add a price period covering {day} to {contract}. To compare an offer over past days, its first price period can start before the offer existed. Costs resume as soon as the period is saved.

missing_price_official.title: {contract} has no regulated price for {day}
missing_price_official.description: The regulated prices have no price for this kind of contract at {kva} kVA on {day}: the costs of {contract} stop on that day. Check the subscribed power of {contract}, or price it by hand.

weather_unavailable.title: Open-Meteo weather can't be updated
weather_unavailable.description: The outdoor temperature couldn't be downloaded from Open-Meteo since {since} ({error}). {title} keeps the hours it already has, and the costs aren't affected.
